meta.description: Claude Code 훅 우선순위 관리자. AskUserQuestion 기반 인터랙티브 UI로 훅 스캔, 우선순위 조정, 오케스트레이터 적용/복원, 개별 훅 토글을 수행합니다. 사용자가 훅, hooks, 훅 관리, hook priority, 훅 우선순위, 오케스트레이터, orchestrator, 훅 설정, hook 설정, 훅 순서, hook order를 언급할 때마다 반드시 이 스킬을 사용하세요. Use when: hooks, 훅, hook priority, 훅 관리, orchestrator, 오케스트레이터, 훅 설정, 훅 순서

copy.tagline: 调整开发工具钩子的执行顺序与开关状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 Claude Code 中管理多个钩子并需要精确控制它们的执行顺序。
copy.tagline_en: Adjust Claude Code hook priorities and enablement
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Claude Code and want to fine-tune its hook execution.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用问答菜单管理 Claude Code 的钩子：扫描当前钩子、预览改动、把多个钩子合并成按优先级依次执行的编排器(triflux 优先)、恢复原状、单独开关或改某个钩子的优先级。
howto.when: 每当用户提到“hooks”、“훅”等钩子相关词，或要求管理钩子、编排器、钩子顺序时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看现在有哪些 hook
say.note: 会扫描并列出当前 hook 状态。

say.text: 把所有 hook 合并成编排器，让 triflux 优先执行
say.note: 会先展示 diff，确认后应用。

say.text: 把 omc-headless-guard 的优先级改成 50
say.note: 会调整该 hook 的优先级。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude manages Claude Code hooks via prompts: scans hooks, previews diffs, applies an orchestrator that runs hooks in priority order (triflux first), restores originals, and toggles individual hook priority.
howto.when_en: Whenever the user mentions hook-related keywords like “hooks” or Korean “훅”, or asks to manage hooks, the orchestrator, or hook order.

say_en.text: Show me what hooks are currently configured.
say_en.note: Scans and lists current hook status.

say_en.text: Merge all hooks into the orchestrator and make triflux run first.
say_en.note: Shows a diff, then applies after confirmation.

say_en.text: Change the priority of omc-headless-guard to 50.
